title: checkride run summary
description: Schema for .check/summary.json — the aggregate report every run writes. A public API for agents and gate consumers. Fields are additive under schema_version 1: they are added (in lockstep with this schema), never renamed, removed, or retyped without a version bump. See docs/contract.md.

schema_version.description: Version of this report shape. Bumped only for a breaking (non-additive) change.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 time the report was written.

ok.description: True when every check passed (skipped checks count as ok). Can be vacuous — see checks_run.

checks_run.description: Count of checks that actually executed (skipped entries excluded). ok=true with checks_run=0 is a vacuous green: nothing was verified. Gate consumers should treat it as a failure (or run with --strict, which exits 2).

total_duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the whole execution phase, in milliseconds — not the sum of the per-check durations, which is larger whenever checks ran concurrently. The two are equal only when execution was sequential (including any --bail run). A run whose checks finish before git answers for the git field waits for it, at most 5 seconds from the run's start, and counts the wait here. The run STARTED at timestamp - total_duration_ms; readers use that to judge whether an artifact belongs to this run.

run.description: What the run selected, and whether it saw the whole pipeline.

git.description: The work tree the run read. Present when the working directory is in a git work tree whose HEAD names a commit, and git answered within 5 seconds.

targets.description: Present in multi-target mode, when checkride.config.json declares targets: each target the run checked, in config order. A later run in the same output directory reads it to delete the directories of targets the config dropped.

checks.description: One entry per selected check, in pipeline order: group sequence, then catalogue position, then repo-scope before target-scope, then target order, then custom checks in config order.

name.description: Slot name (e.g. lint), or a custom check's key; <target>:<slot> (e.g. web:lint) for a target's check in multi-target mode.

target.description: Present in multi-target mode on a target-scope check: the target it belongs to.

slot.description: Present on every check in multi-target mode: the catalogue slot (lint) or custom check name the check fills.

pack.description: Present on every check in multi-target mode: the pack that fills it, its target's for a target-scope check (ts) and repo for a check of the repo as a whole, a top-level custom check included.

cwd.description: Present when the check ran from a directory other than the repo root, as a target's check does when its root isn't .: that directory, relative to the repo root.

adapter.description: Adapter that ran (e.g. oxlint), or null when the slot resolved to nothing.

ok.description: Pass/fail after any baseline masking; skipped checks are ok.

skipped.description: Present (true) when the check did not execute; see reason.

reason.description: Why a skipped check sat out (no tool detected, disabled in config, unavailable under this package manager, ...).

exit_code.description: The tool's exit code; -1 for spawn failure or timeout; null when skipped.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration in milliseconds (0 when skipped).

output_file.description: The file holding the tool's raw JSON output, when it emits JSON on stdout, relative to the output directory (.check/ unless --out named another). A target's check writes into the target's directory there, so its file is <target>/<file> (e.g. web/lint.json).

origin.description: Present exactly when adapter is not null: why the check is in the run. config when checkride.config.json (presets included) names the slot, detected when a detection signal chose the adapter, built-in when detection chose an adapter that needs no signal, custom for a config-only custom check.

detected_by.description: Present when origin is detected: the signal that chose the adapter, as the matched detect file, package.json: <dep> or package.json: scripts.<name>.

argv.description: Present when the check spawned its own tool: the command and its arguments exactly as spawned, after package-manager translation (the canonical pnpm exec oxlint runs as npx --no-install oxlint under npm). A tool that failed to start or timed out keeps the argv it was given. Built-ins, which checkride runs itself, and skipped checks have none.

pin_source.description: Present when the check's tool resolved through a pin source, the first one in its pack's pin chain to declare it: js-lockfile for a pnpm exec tool or a package script run through the project's package manager, mise for a tool a mise.toml or .mise.toml in the repo names under [tools], or path for a tool nothing declared, found on PATH and so unpinned. override, go-mod-tool, rust-toolchain, uv-lock and tf-version belong to packs and a flag checkride doesn't have yet, so no run writes them. A command spawned as written, a built-in, a check refused before it spawned and a skipped check have none.

tool_version.description: Present with pin_source when a file read found the version of the tool that ran, never by running it: for js-lockfile, the version in node_modules/<package>/package.json nearest the check's directory. Absent for mise and path, whose version mise or the machine decides.

baselined.description: Present only when a committed baseline masked diagnostics: how many current findings are grandfathered.

partial.description: True when --only, --skip or --changed narrowed the run, or --bail stopped it at a failure. It is the test the baseline ratchet applies, so a partial run never prunes checkride.baseline.json.

only.description: Present when --only was given: the names it listed.

skip.description: Present when --skip was given: the names it listed.

include.description: Present when --include was given: the names it listed.

static_only.description: Present when --static-only was given. checkride has no such flag yet, so no run writes it.

discover.description: Present when --discover was given. checkride has no such flag yet, so no run writes it.

config.description: Present when --config or CHECKRIDE_CONFIG named the config file: its absolute path.

defaults.description: Present when --defaults or CHECKRIDE_DEFAULTS was given: the file's absolute path. checkride has no such flag yet, so no run writes it.

pins.description: Present when --pins or CHECKRIDE_PINS was given: the file's absolute path. checkride has no such flag yet, so no run writes it.

out.description: Present when --out or CHECKRIDE_OUT named the output directory: its absolute path.

head.description: The full sha HEAD named as the run started.

dirty.description: True when git status --porcelain listed anything, untracked files included: the checks read changes head doesn't hold.

base.description: Present under --changed: the base the run measured changes from.

ref.description: The base as named by --base, CHECKRIDE_BASE or changedBase, or origin/main or HEAD when nothing named one.

name.description: The target's name, as checkride.config.json declares it; its checks are named <name>:<slot> and write under <out>/<name>/.

pack.description: The pack that checks the target (ts).

root.description: The directory its target-scope checks run from, relative to the repo root and normalized: . for the root itself.

discovered.description: Present when --discover proposed the target rather than the config declaring it. checkride has no such flag yet, so no run writes it.
